baseline.description: Cloud SQL schema after the platform billing rebuild and before Shiprocket logistics

migrations.description: Shiprocket logistics, fulfilment orders, shipments, and immutable parcel snapshots
Repair the production credit-note formatter and canonicalize the legacy scheduled-plan constraint
Record actual pickup preparation separately from the checkout promise
Mark paid one-time AI-credit invoices as paid instead of subscription debt

queries.name: paid AI-credit purchases have no collectible invoice
queries.sql: select count(*)::text from public.billing_invoices invoice join public.ai_credit_purchases purchase on purchase.invoice_id = invoice.id where purchase.status = 'paid' and invoice.kind = 'ai_credits' and invoice.status in ('draft', 'open', 'processing')

migrations.description: Persist bounded personal Analytics dashboard layouts per store admin
Persist tenant-safe Search Console source epochs, metric buckets, leased work, and fleet rate limits
Add operator-controlled Analytics availability and seed the first Analytics help documents

queries.name: the Analytics help overview is published
queries.sql: select count(*)::text from public.help_articles where slug = 'understand-analytics-dashboard' and status = 'published'

migrations.description: Publish the complete Analytics Help Centre guide set and prepare detailed GA4 and Meta Pixel setup drafts

queries.name: eight shipped Analytics guides are published
queries.sql: select count(*)::text from public.help_articles where slug in ('understand-analytics-dashboard', 'analytics-terms-and-data-sources', 'analytics-sales-and-orders', 'analytics-customers-inventory-and-activity', 'understand-google-search-analytics', 'analytics-reports-and-csv', 'customize-analytics-dashboard', 'analytics-troubleshooting') and status = 'published'

queries.name: merchant pixel setup guides remain drafts
queries.sql: select count(*)::text from public.help_articles where slug in ('connect-google-analytics-4', 'connect-meta-pixel') and status = 'draft'

migrations.description: Require every published Help article to have the category needed by its canonical URL

queries.name: no published Help article is missing its canonical category
queries.sql: select count(*)::text from public.help_articles where status = 'published' and category_id is null

migrations.description: Enable Pro merchant GA4 and Meta Pixel modules and publish their consent-aware setup guides

queries.name: merchant pixel modules are globally available
queries.sql: select count(*)::text from public.platform_analytics_settings where id = true and google_analytics_4 = true and meta_pixel = true

queries.name: merchant pixel setup guides are published
queries.sql: select count(*)::text from public.help_articles where slug in ('connect-google-analytics-4', 'connect-meta-pixel') and status = 'published'

migrations.description: Add consented first-party storefront events, temporary order attribution, durable daily funnel aggregates, and its Help guide

queries.name: storefront conversion is available and documented
queries.sql: select count(*)::text from public.platform_analytics_settings s where s.id = true and s.storefront_conversion = true and exists (select 1 from public.help_articles a where a.slug = 'understand-storefront-conversion-analytics' and a.status = 'published')

migrations.description: Add nullable product and variant costs, immutable order-line cost snapshots, enable Pro gross-margin analytics, and publish its Help guide

queries.name: gross margin is available and documented
queries.sql: select count(*)::text from public.platform_analytics_settings s where s.id = true and s.gross_margin = true and exists (select 1 from public.help_articles a where a.slug = 'understand-gross-margin-analytics' and a.status = 'published')

migrations.description: Attribute each POS tender to the drawer shift that captured it

queries.name: legacy shifted payments are backfilled
queries.sql: select count(*)::text from public.order_payments p join public.orders o on o.id = p.order_id where o.shift_id is not null and p.shift_id is null

migrations.description: Cascade every direct store relationship so permanent tenant deletion leaves no detached rows

queries.name: every direct store foreign key cascades on deletion
queries.sql: select count(*)::text from pg_constraint where contype = 'f' and confrelid = 'public.stores'::regclass and confdeltype <> 'c'
